Definition: Emim, an early Canaanitish (or Maobitish) tribe
BiblicalUsage: Emim is an early Canaanitish (or Maobitish) tribe. In Genesis 14:5, the text says "and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Emim matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
RelatedEvents: Abram Rescues Lot; The Defeat of Sihon and Og
